findings.issue: Not glossary-frozen, but 'Barkeep'/'Tavern Keeper' is rendered صاحب الحانة in all seven other rows of this corpus - including 'Tavern Keeper' two rows away in this same shop widget. This prompt alone calls him الساقي, so one screen names the NPC twice, differently.
'Nameless' is rendered بلا اسم elsewhere in the corpus ('Nameless Pass' = مَعبَر بلا اسم). المجهول means 'unknown', which is a claim about who he is rather than about his lacking a name.

findings.source_en: A reverberation from the Underglade that mends wounds and knits flesh anew. There is no question that the Harbinger has been bred for a task no mortal could undertake.
findings.ar: صدىً من الأجمة السفلى يرأب الجراح ويعيد نسج اللحم. لا شكّ أن النذير استُولد لمهمّةٍ لا يطيقها فانٍ.
findings.issue: A glade is a clearing in a forest; أجمة is a dense thicket - the opposite feature. The 'Under-' half correctly mirrors Undermether = الأُمَّهة السُّفلى, so only the second element is wrong.
findings.suggested_ar: صدىً من الفَسحة السفلى يرأب الجراح ويعيد نسج اللحم. لا شكّ أن النذير استُولد لمهمّةٍ لا يطيقها فانٍ.
